item.tib: sku gsum yongs rdzogs pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsol 'debs gser phreng bsam pa myur 'grub
item.coloph: zhes gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub zhes bya ba 'di ni shing sprel zla 10tshes 3la lung bzhin gsang sngags gling pas gnas mchog brag dkar rdo rje yongs rdzong nas dngos grub tu brnyes (rnyed) te/ slar shing bya zla 6 tshes 10 la sku tshab mkha' 'gro'i brda yi yi ge bzhugs pa bod yig tu phab pas gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig/
